key_concepts: Force is a push or pull on an object
A pull moves an object toward the source of force
A push moves an object away from the source of force
Force can change the movement of objects, things, and persons
Force can change the size, shape, texture, and movement of an object
Either a push or a pull can stop an object from moving
The effect of force depends on the kind of force applied
Kalinga indigenous games such as sese-eng, sanggul, kadang-kadang, and ginnulluy involve p
In sese-eng, players bump each other to outbalance the opponent
Everyday actions like throwing, pressing, lifting, and opening a refrigerator require push
